description: The untrusted-data fence markers (`<<<PENSMITH_UNTRUSTED_DATA_<uuid>>>>` / `<<<END_PENSMITH_UNTRUSTED_DATA_<uuid>>>>`) and their UUID have ONE home, bin/lib/untrusted-fence.ts: it alone builds a fenced block (fenceUntrusted), strips a marker that appears inside fenced data (stripFenceMarkers) and reads a block back (unfence). A second copy of the marker text is a fence an attacker's source record can close early, or a check that drifts from the one the templates describe. Call fenceUntrusted() / unfence() / stripFenceMarkers() / FENCE_OPEN / FENCE_CLOSE instead.
